title: Works great
text: Works great. Bought this for my 2008 MBZ ML350, fits pretty well and is easy to maneuver and situate. Love that it is not too stiff because it makes it easier to use. This is a great alternative to a MUCH more expensive model, made specifically for my car, which I returned because it was way too stiff and difficult to use. This one is perfect for my needs and hopefully will hold up for a few years.  UPDATE:  After using for a few weeks, and in HOT weather, discovered this HEATS up so much you can literally barely touch it!!!!  Just use caution in very hot weather!!!
